29.speaker: Player_Romus
29.text: “To remind you that sometimes, in order to serve a greater good, we must turn against the ones we love."

30.speaker: Player_Romus
30.text: "Setting aside the Uprising of 1926, what would you consider the most turbulent period of unrest in the kingdom’s history?"

31.speaker: Player_Romus
31.text: "I trust everyone here is familiar with the War of Rizian Succession.”

32.speaker: Hugo Toras
32.text: “I will assume you're speaking rhetorically, Your Majesty.”

33.speaker: Player_Romus
33.text: "Correct. Ariana was forced into a bitter feud with her own blood relations, and she did what she had to do to survive."

34.speaker: Player_Romus
34.text: "Time for a little quiz. How did House Toras secure the throne all those years ago?"

35.speaker: Player_Romus
35.text: “Ambition shattered familial bonds, leading to the deaths of many and a nation torn apart.”

36.speaker: Player_Romus
36.text: "Ah, good to know someone’s paying attention."

37.speaker: Hubertus Toras
37.text: "Why, it was a direct result of the War of Rizian Succession, Your Majesty."

38.speaker: Hubertus Toras
38.text: "The war was one of the most violent chapters in our nation's history. Which nonetheless ended in triumph when Ariana Toras took her rightful place on the throne."

39.speaker: Hugo Toras
39.text: 'The War of Rizian Succession, of course."

40.speaker: Player_Romus

41.speaker: Player_Romus
41.text: "Funny how historical betrayal tends to repeat itself."

45.speaker: Rico Toras

85.text: "My ancestor Fedo arrogantly tried to assert his claim to the throne. When Ariana Toras took the crown, she showed him great mercy by allowing our house to retain power."

86.speaker: Taddeus Azaro

141.text: "Evidence? As King, my authority requires no justification -- only decisive action."

142.speaker: Player_Romus
142.text: "Stop playing dumb. I know every detail of your plan."

143.speaker: Player_Romus
143.text: "Divine will does not require proof -- it demands obedience."

147.speaker: Player_Romus
147.text: "I AM the evidence. My word alone shapes the truth in this realm. Everyone here would do well to remember that."

159.text: "Justice? What is it that you think House Azaro has done?"

161.text: "'Justice? What is it that you think we've done?"

162.speaker: Player_Romus
162.text: "It was my ancestor Ariana who forced the Azaros into an alliance. By beating them into submission."

163.speaker: Player_Romus
163.text: "To this day... and not a moment longer."

164.speaker: Player_Romus
164.text: "You're conveniently forgetting what happened before that. The treachery of your ancestress, Ana."

165.speaker: Player_Romus
165.text: "Yes, our houses were aligned for over a hundred years. Your service to the kingdom has been invaluable. And yet..."

173.speaker: Lucita Azaro
173.text: "A brutal battle, but one that solidified the bond between House Azaro and House Toras. An alliance that continues to this day."

174.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
174.text: "A brutal battle. But one that redefined warfare as Merkopa knew it. Techniques were developed that are still in use now."

175.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
175.text: "And let us not forget the bonds that were forged between House Toras and House Azaro at the war's end. An alliance that has continued to this day."

180.speaker: Hubertus Toras
180.text: "His Majesty doesn't owe you an explanation."

186.speaker: Player_Romus
186.text: "Your blood ties to the King don't make you immune from justice."

187.speaker: Player_Romus
187.text: "Look at you. Speaking up to defend me while preparing to drive a knife through my back."

189.speaker: Player_Romus
189.text: "House Toras shall not escape my judgement either, Hubertus."

190.speaker: Player_Romus
190.text: "You can't fool me, Hugo. I know you've always wanted my throne for yourself."

198.speaker: Leona Sazon
198.text: "It is your right to mete out justice, Your Majesty. But please believe that House Sazon knows its place."

200.speaker: Hugo Toras
200.text: "Valenqiris, Your Majesty? I must have misheard you..."

201.speaker: Player_Romus
201.text: "I know you're my uncle. But honestly, I never could stand you."

205.speaker: Rico Toras
205.text: "You can't talk to my father like that!"

206.speaker: Hugo Toras
206.text: "For God's sake, Romus, please be reasonable!"

207.speaker: Player_Romus
207.text: "We learned the wrong lessons from the War of Succession. Noble houses only lead to strife. The monarch must reign over all."

208.speaker: Player_Romus
208.text: "After today, you will know your place for good."

212.speaker: Angelica Sazon
212.text: "Do not judge us on the basis of Lucas or Fedo's actions. I promise we are innocent."

213.speaker: Narrator

223.text: By this point, everyone in the room was staring at me in disbelief.

225.speaker: Player_Romus
225.text: "No more excuses. Every one of you will pay!"

227.speaker: Player_Romus
227.text: "I ask for your full cooperation. Starting right... this... second."

230.speaker: Leona Sazon
230.text: "It resulted in an established order among the Royal Houses. One that continues to this day."

234.speaker: Leona Sazon
234.text: "And barring the actions of certain individuals -- acting without the rest of the House's knowledge, mind you -- we have been repaying that mercy every day since."

237.speaker: Player_Romus
237.text: "All these years, and House Sazon still doesn't know its place."

238.speaker: Player_Romus
238.text: "Ariana Toras should have executed your ancestors. As the 1926 Uprising proved."

239.speaker: Player_Romus
239.text: "I am afraid that I, King Romus, am significantly less merciful than Queen Ariana was."

240.speaker: Player_Romus
240.text: "We all witnessed how your golden boy Manus tried to weasel his way into my daughter's heart."

241.speaker: Leona Sazon
241.text: "I don't know what it is you think we did, Your Majesty, but you're wrong."

245.speaker: Player_Romus
245.text: "Your golden boy Manus may have weaseled his way into my daughter's heart, but not mine."

246.speaker: Player_Romus
246.text: "All this time, you've been waiting patiently for the right moment to rise up again. Not on my watch."

247.speaker: Player_Romus
247.text: "You have the intelligence to know your place. But as for Angelica... I'm not so sure."

251.speaker: Player_Romus
251.text: "Did you or did you not try to stoke the fires of revolution in Rizia? Answer me!"

255.speaker: Player_Romus
255.text: "I don't have to justify myself to you or anyone else."

256.speaker: Leona Sazon
256.text: "Please, Your Majesty. There must still be a way to settle this peacefully."

257.speaker: Angelica Sazon
257.text: "You pardoned me, and now you don't trust me?"

258.speaker: Manus Sazon
258.text: "Vina will find out about this, Your Majesty. She'll never stand for it."

262.text: "Traitors like you don't deserve peace, Countess. You've earned whatever punishment His Majesty has in store."
